```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5.5, fig.align = "center",
                      dpi = 100, out.width = "100%")
```

NetFunrankR tests whether a gene list is *closer* to a pathway in the
protein-protein interaction (PPI) network than degree-matched random genes,
and splits that evidence into

* **overlap**: query genes annotated to the pathway (degree-aware test), and
* **beyond overlap**: query genes *not* annotated to the pathway but close to
  its members in the network.

Both parts are tested against exact (permutation-free) null distributions and
combined with Fisher's method; the two p-values are independent under the
null, so the combination is valid.

## Quick start

```{r}
library(NetFunrankR)

net  <- string_network("noKB")   # STRING v12 without database/text-mining channels
kegg <- load_pathways("KEGG")
net
```

```{r}
res <- nf_proximity_test(COPD_proteinCodingGenes, kegg, net, max_size = 500)
res$evidence <- nf_evidence_class(res)
head(res[, c("set", "overlap", "overlap_expected", "d_c", "d_c_expected",
             "p_overlap", "p_beyond", "p_combined", "fdr_combined", "evidence")], 10)
table(res$evidence)
```

Columns:

| column | meaning |
|---|---|
| `overlap`, `overlap_expected` | observed and degree-expected number of query genes in the set |
| `d_c`, `d_c_expected` | mean shortest-path distance from query genes to the set |
| `p_overlap` | degree-aware overlap test (Poisson-binomial) |
| `p_beyond` | proximity of non-member query genes, conditional on the overlap |
| `p_proximity` | total closest-distance proximity |
| `p_combined` | Fisher combination of `p_overlap` and `p_beyond` |
| `p_hyper` | classical hypergeometric ORA, for reference |
| `linker_genes` | query genes adjacent to (but not in) the set |

## Plots

```{r}
plot_evidence_map(res)
```

```{r}
top <- res$set[res$evidence == "network only"][1]
if (!is.na(top)) plot_linker_network(COPD_proteinCodingGenes, kegg[[top]], net) +
  ggplot2::ggtitle(top)
```

```{r}
nd <- nf_null_distribution(COPD_proteinCodingGenes, kegg, net, res$set[1])
plot_null(nd, "S", title = res$set[1])
```

## Many queries, custom networks and backgrounds

Distances from every node to every gene set are computed once per library and
can be reused:

```{r, eval = FALSE}
D <- set_distances(net, kegg)
lapply(my_gene_lists, nf_proximity_test, genesets = kegg, net = net, D = D)
```

Any edge list can be used as network (`nf_network(edges)`). For expression
data, pass the measured genes as `background` so that null genes are drawn
only from genes that could have been called differentially expressed.

## One-call wrapper

```{r, eval = FALSE}
NetFunrankR_wrapper(COPD_proteinCodingGenes, PE_ORA_pop = "KEGG",
                    outdir = "NetFunrankR_results")
```

writes the result table and the evidence map, Venn diagram, comparison and
linker-network plots (PDF and ggplot2 objects).
